paper_title: Knowing You Don't Know Learning When to Continue Search in Multi-round   RAG through Self-Practicing
caption: Ablation study on different Inner Monologue turns on HotPotQA. The green line represents the Naive Generation baseline, while the blue line shows the performance of SIM-RAGlite. The red line indicates the EM score using the ground-truth label as an Oracle Critic.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates how EM score varies with the number of “Turns of Inner Monologue” for three methods shown in the legend. The x-axis is labeled “Turns of Inner Monologue,” uses a linear scale, and spans integer values from 0 to 6 with tick labels at every 1 turn. The y-axis is labeled “EM (%),” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 50, with major tick labels at 10-point intervals (0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50). Three solid lines with “x” markers are shown: the red line (SIM-RAG (Oracle Critic)) increases across the x-axis, starting at about 20% at turn 0 and rising through approximately 30% (turn 1), 35% (turn 2), 39% (turn 3), 42% (turn 4), 44% (turn 5), and ending near 47% at turn 6; the blue line (SIM-RAG (lite)) also increases, beginning around 15% at turn 0 and moving to roughly 21% (turn 1), 24% (turn 2), 25–26% (turn 3), 26–27% (turn 4), 28% (turn 5), and about 30% at turn 6; the green line (Naive Gen) remains flat at approximately 20% for all turns from 0 through 6.
